title: Validated Prokaryotic Expression Cassette
description: Annotated linear GenBank expression cassette containing a bacterial promoter, ribosome binding site, verified GFP open reading frame, and terminator.
code:
LOCUS       pExpr_GFP                135 bp    ds-DNA  linear   SYN 24-NOV-2026
DEFINITION  Prokaryotic constitutive GFP expression cassette.
ACCESSION   pExpr_GFP
VERSION     pExpr_GFP.1
KEYWORDS    synthetic biology; expression cassette; GFP.
SOURCE      synthetic DNA construct
  ORGANISM  Escherichia coli

     promoter        7..20
                     /label="pJ23100"
     RBS             21..30
                     /label="B0034"
     CDS             31..111
                     /gene="gfp_mini"
                     /product="Mini green fluorescent protein"
                     /codon_start=1
                     /translation="MSKGEELFTGVVPILVELDGDVNGHK"

        1 gaattcttga caaagaggaa aagaggagaa atgtctaaag gtgaagaact gttcaccggt
